notes.title: New Game "Final_SIM" Releasing Soon!
notes.content:
Hey everybody!

I know its been a while, but I wanted to return to inform you that my new game will be releasing very soon! It is titled "Final_SIM" and I believe fans of this game will appreciate it very much. I hope you take the time to check it out and add it to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/997280/Final_SIM/

notes.title: SEEK OR DIE V.2.0 OUT NOW!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Yep, Seek Or Die V.2.0 is RELEASED![/h1]

Hey everyone!

I know I usually don't meet my deadlines, but hey, there's a first time for everything.

Seek Or Die V.2.0 is a [u]major[/u] update to the game. It addresses many bugs and problems V.1.3 had. 

If you want to play V.1.3 again (for some reason) I kept an open branch that can be accessed through the "Betas" tab of the Properties menu for my game.

[b]Seek Or Die V.2.0 Includes:[/b]
- A REAL monster
- A story-line
- Multiple endings
- Multiple objectives 
- Additive distractions that make Part I more difficult
- Little bits and bobs to make the game run smoother
- A donate button (my favorite feature)

Thank you all for supporting me as I develop this game. The amount of community support has been overwhelming and I never expected to get this far. So thank you.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32327305/c031dc707ce3955f674fda357931ce90b1e805ef.png[/img]

-Flashynurav

notes.title: Vote Now! Should I Change the Map?
notes.content:
[h1]This is VERY important, so please take some time to read.[/h1]

So someone commented under my update post that I should consider changing the map of the house because it is a demo package and not hand-created. I do recognize that this seems lazy, HOWEVER: it is in no way wrong/illegal. The mansion layout was part of a bigger package and I am free to use it as I see fit. 

Still, it matters what you guys think more than what I think. If you believe I should create my own map, I will gladly do so. This DOES mean that the update will need to be pushed another month. 

Tell me what you think in the comments, should I make my own map or no?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32327305/c031dc707ce3955f674fda357931ce90b1e805ef.png[/img]

-Flashynurav

notes.title: I NEED YOUR HELP!
notes.content:
Hey guys, so the update is ALMOST finished!

I don't want it to be released just yet however. Contact ANY AND ALL you-tubers and tell them to contact me at "varunananth1@gmail.com" in order to generate publicity for the update. They will get a beta copy for the game as well as a spot in the credits (not much but its what I can do).

One big regret about my initial lunch of "Seek Or Die" was that I did not publicize my game enough. I want to change that. However, I cannot do it alone. If you guys could do this it would really help a small game developer out.

Spread the word so other people can scream along with you!

notes.title: This Game Is NOT Multiplayer!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, there has been some confusion as to whether or not this game is multiplayer. It is NOT MULTIPLAYER. Someone added the multiplayer tag and I cannot remove it alone. Please press the "+" next to the tags and report the multiplayer tag so that it can be removed and won't confuse anyone else. Thank you.

-Flashynurav

notes.title: An Apology... (PLEASE READ)
notes.content:
This is an apology to anyone who is interested in my game.
First off, thank you for the support you have given me by checking out my page, commenting under announcements, etc.
However, it has been brought to my attention that the "eye" logo I branded my game with is actually Intellectual Property of the creator of "EYES, The Horror Game". 
I was originally going to publish anyway because I believed that few would notice the similarities, but when I realized the attention this game was garnering, I couldn't lie back.
I am working with the steam user "Rob Boss" to create new artwork custom-tailored to my game. He is also helping me with beta testing. (I couldn't have progressed without him).
This will take a while, but the finished product will be a polished game, not a rushed B-Class game. First impressions matter so I want to do a perfect release of my game.
Thank you for all your support.

-Flashynurav
